This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989 against the order dated 23.02.2024 passed by Special Judge SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, Sagar whereby appellant's bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in relation to Crime No.
44/2024 registered at Police Station Kesli, District Sagar (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 376(2)(h) of IPC and Sections 3(1)(w)(1), 3(2)(5-A) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act was dismissed.

On the basis of aforesaid, offence has been registered against the appellant.

sentences.text: At the time of incident, she was aged about 25 years.
There is no criminal antecedent of the appellant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
Trial of the case will take time.
Therefore, it is prayed that appellant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail to the appellant.

5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the appellant is not warranted.
Consequently, this appeal under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 is allowed.
Impugned order dated 23.02.2024 passed by Special Judge SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, Sagar is set aside.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. It is directed that appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
